source: Project Operating System Phase 3.5 - Governance Hardening
name: Content Contract
objective: Define future article and editorial asset registry responsibilities.

boundary.coreContracts: content knowledge capabilities, concepts, sources and domains
boundary.posContracts: operational lifecycle, registry, migration, testing and approval process for content

notes: Existing articles do not consume this contract.
NEW_ARTICLE and MIGRATED_ARTICLE must resolve the seven article gates before generation or publication.
Heuristic editorial checks support review and must not be described as perfect semantic analysis.
POS does not become a source of legal content knowledge; it orchestrates future content operations.
